music.name: Stellar Tracks
music.author: MaxStack
music.description: This is music that was made for a cancelled video game. The album was called Game-Game, but I chose to name it Stellar Tracks because I liked the music so much! I also get the feeling of a cosmic train going to different worlds.

music.name: Endgame: Singularity
music.author: MaxStack
music.description: This music combines strong melodies with an ominous feel. That is quite rare (I don't know why), but it works really well here.

music.name: Carnival Rides
music.author: Écrivain
music.description: This is a short but fun track. It gives me the feeling of a fast minecart.

music.name: Telling a Tale
music.author: Remaxim
music.description: Another short track, this one evokes the atmosphere of a medieval campfire. It is quite compelling!

music.name: Left and Right Excluded
music.author: Matthew Klingensmith
music.description: If jazz music was combined with a video game boss theme, this would be the result. It is both unusual and fun!

music.name: Debugging
music.author: Martin Linda
music.description: This music has two distinct stages. It gives me the feeling of a programmer working at high speed. I would have bought this if it was being sold!
